supersedes_before_measurement.scope: Only fresh_performance_gate.strict_acceptance is replaced. Every workload, artifact, topology, scenario, window, width, repetition, execution order, correctness requirement, implementation constraint, held-out rule, and terminal one-shot rule remains frozen by v1.

authority.source: explicit user direction in the active development session
authority.direction: Relax the zero-tolerance broad-slice performance gate somewhat.
authority.reason: A 1.0000 point-estimate ceiling is tighter than the measurement precision and rejects noise-sized tradeoffs despite a large general speedup.

replacement_strict_acceptance.artifact_pairs: one frozen V17/V23 pair per topology and width

interpretation.required_general_win: The overall gate still requires at least a 20 percent runtime reduction versus V17.
interpretation.broad_tradeoff_budget: A predefined broad slice may be at most 1 percent slower, separating a material regression from sub-percent measurement noise.
interpretation.cell_guard: No individual cell may exceed the existing 5 percent regression ceiling.
interpretation.no_post_hoc_membership: The exact 1,944-cell lattice and all aggregation memberships remain unchanged.

decision_rules.on_failure: Seal immutable refusal; do not retest or tune this identity.
decision_rules.on_success: Require independent review and a fresh formal qualification identity before selection or deployment.
